definition: ActualConcreteTargetAt A Concrete w b explicitly asserts Concrete b and A.ontic.ExistsAt w b. Facts have the existing Fact B O sum type; this selects an actual individual without identifying a fact label, joint condition or ground record with that individual.
note: Source-inspired analyst interface, not a direct binding of an unbound source sentence or a derivation from the owner’s accepted existence alone. Concreteness is retained in the SAME-target helper; the registered NecessaryBeing endpoint forgets it. No dummy Profile or new causal relation is constructed. Concrete uses the same supplied world-independent designation as DEF-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD; no materiality or causal-capacity criterion is built in.
